verdict.what_happens: The five-block stack stands initially, then a pusher drives the bottom block to the right and the stack topples.

usage.text:
The blocks initially form an upright stack. A low pusher moves in from the left and pushes the bottom block to the right, causing the upper blocks to lean and collapse. The plan view shows the resulting spread mostly along the pushing direction. This matches the brief.
